areas.t: Cleaner and slightly cooler air has moved in for Thursday. Air quality is Green (good) statewide. High pressure will be centered over the region tonight and Friday. Light winds may lead to a bit of stagnation. Air quality in most areas should remain Green, but particulate could inch upward towards Y
